title: SD Gundam Force
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes): the HUD's "HP x 3" -> "HP x 2" after a lost life matched a byte at 0x030043D5 (copy at 0x02020842)

widgets.text:
Health; Captain Gundam, Zero, Bakunetsumaru
Play as the Gundam Force heroes against the Dark Axis
Health bar per hero; switching heroes mid-stage lets you use the right attack for each enemy

rows: ranged beam shots; Zero: flying knight with a sword; Bakunetsumaru: samurai with twin blades

widgets.text: Combo attacks chain hits; the max-combo counter is tracked by the game

Stage-end bosses
Stage bosses are Dark Axis commanders; hit them between attack patterns
Use the hero whose range fits the boss: flyers for air targets, melee for armored ones

Story stages
Stages from the ROM's menus include the Construction Site and the Dark Axis Tower, plus an Extra stage

rows: Max Combo, Speed, Survival and Boss attack

widgets.text:
Power-ups
Power-ups dropped by enemies restore health or boost attacks for a while

Unlocks
Challenge modes keep their own records (combo, time, survival, boss)
The Extra stage opens after the main story

Stages cleared
Clear the story stages to the Dark Axis Tower, then the challenge modes for records
